comparison.objective: Candidate separates finishing media from washers; record takes a tympanic temperature on a manikin.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests granular flow and bounded agitation; record tests precise probe alignment/insertion, button actuation and submillimetric steadiness during measurement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades recovery mass, retention and spill-free released placement; record requires valid seated measurement, a 3 s motion-bounded hold, safe depth and final thermometer release.
comparison.reason: Probe seating and measurement stability test fine insertion and hold control, not bulk rigid-body separation.
